## How it was verified

<!--
Static review is not enough for behaviour changes. Say what you actually ran:
Debug build, Release build, the regression script, a real MEGA link, a specific window size or DPI.
If something was not tested, say so — that is more useful than silence.
-->

- [ ] `Debug` builds
- [ ] `Release` builds
- [ ] `.\Tests\Run-RegressionTests.ps1` passes
- [ ] Tested with a real MEGA link (describe what: file / folder / subfolder / encrypted)

## Checklist

- [ ] No new warnings in the build output
- [ ] New UI strings added to all 10 language packs under `Resources/Language/` (or reused an existing key)
- [ ] `docs/CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] READMEs updated if behaviour, requirements or version numbers changed
- [ ] No unrelated reformatting or whitespace noise in the diff
- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING](docs/CONTRIBUTING.md)
